messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Assalam o Alaikum, aap ki OLX listing dekhi Honda 125 ki. Paise tayyar hain full price par.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Ji 145,000 final hai, bike Lahore mein hai.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Main Islamabad se hoon, army mein hoon posting mein nahi aa sakta. Bike ship kara dein, main pehle advance de deta hoon.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Sirf 5,000 booking fee hai jo OLX ke shipping partner ko deni hai, ye Easypaisa number: 0322-XXXXX88.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: OLX mein shipping service hoti hai? Mujhe to pata hi nahi.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Naya service launch hua hai. Fee bhejte hi main full payment transfer kar deta hoon aaj hi, deal confirm karo turant.
